Download maps into your smartphone, enjoy best-ever riding NOW!

Garmin Real Directions
Get spoken turn-by-turn directions through your connected helmet or headset.
Meanwhile, navigation features are projected to motorcycle meter panel when smartphone is connected to motorcycle via Bluetooth®.

Live Traffic
Avoid traffic delays and find timesaving detours to help keep you on your way with live traffic updates.

PhotoReal Junction View
It displays the appropriate lane to drive in during an active route.
Junction view realistically depicts junctions and interchanges along your route, including road signs and the surrounding landscape;
A brightly colored arrow indicates the lane needed for your next turn or exit.

Rider Alerts
Get alerts for speed zones along your route. You'll be notified about speed limit, speed camera, and school zones.

Live Weather
Show weather, temperature along the ride.

Share the Ride
Share tracks with fellow riders by sending GPX files.
